entry.title: Slay the Spire II v1.1.0
entry.content:
Yes you will need a new APworld but your yaml only needs to change by one line from 1.0.1
## Multiplayer Stuff - Testing was done on beta branch so please use that. I did ZERO testing on the main branch for this. - Universal Buffs don't work, this is normal - they're automatically turned into 5 gold. - If you want to use the website to generate the yaml you sort of can: but you need to add a line for "player_count: 1", value can be 1-4. Also remove the bonus_items line entirely. - You can either make one yaml for each player with "player_count: 1" aka one slot per player and each person joins their own slot. Host determines what ascensions and ascension downs count. Everything else should be player dependent - Alternatively: you can set "player_count: 2" or "player_count: 3" or "player_count: 4" in your yaml and everyone connects to the same slot. THEN in game (before you connect to a slot): you can hit Archipelago Settings -> Multiplayer settings and change your player number - Yes the above system can make you generate a big yaml with like 1000+ checks if you wanted to and you can play that in singleplayer. - There's too many multiplayer adjustments / design decisions that had to be done to get this working so just message in the discord channel if you're curious about something, thanks. Also if you need help setting up just ask. - Everyone needs the Archipelago mod installed, yes. Everyone must have the same mod list (if you've installed other mods like say character mods and discover a bug: your bugs will take less priority, try to only run RitsuLib and this Mod (and maybe BaseLib and modded characters but modded characters are also borked) - If you encounter a state divergence: just host again and try again. If this happens frequently: open the dev console with ` or shift+8 and type "ap report" and then send the zipfile (in discord) that it hopefully opens. state divergences are impossible to debug without this so without it: state divergences occur way way before it actually puts the message in game. - Manually Installing the Mod from GitHub Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. Download the "Archipelago.zip" from Go to your Slay the Spire II directory (In Steam, click "Browse Local Files") If a folder called mods does not exist, create it Unzip the contents of Archipelago.zip into mods If you've done this step correctly, your directory structure should look like this: /<slay-the-spire-2-local-files>/mods/Archipelago/ and the contents of that folder should be a bunch of .dll files and a .pck file (there may be more files too, please don't touch anything in this folder)
## Random Bug Fixes (compared to 1.1.0) - Have 2 saves in multiplayer: recent natural AP checkpoint (ie chests and bosses) and one checkpoint at each floor (probably a temporary adjustment while bugs and state divergences are common so you lose less progress). - Allow disconnecting and connecting to different multiworlds without restarting your game. - Massively overhauled architecture and restructuring of how Beta-Main compatibility works so things might break. - Fix progressive ancients, smiths and rests not being cleared in singleplayer leading to more than expected. - Option descriptions should be improved / better - Add accessibility and progression balancing in the yaml template and options creator (note website isn't updated until this stuff becomes a non experimental thing)

entry.title: The Messenger v0.16.0
entry.content:
# Messenger Randomizer AP
Beta release for Messenger AP with many, many not yet merged changes.
## Mod Changelog since v0.15.2 - Add 4 new locations for the generators in Elemental Skylands (disabled by default) alwaysintreble#23 - Support for deferred entrances in UT alwaysintreble#24 - Improve region tracking for UT and poptracker alwaysintreble#30 - Fix some location names that were different from the Apworld alwaysintreble#29 - Improve logging even more
### New since v0.16.0-beta - Fix connection overlay sometimes not showing up, or not showing when disconnected alwaysintreble#32 - Necro cutscene no longer triggers automatically; you need to grab him - Play a portal animation when entering a boss room from the wrong dimension - Add a dimension portal in *Autumn Hills right* instead of automatically switching - Rework the Lost Woods solve to be only temporarily in transition rando when arriving in *Howling Grotto bottom* - Rewrite transition rando to have only one loading instead of two
## Apworld Changelog official release (no change since v0.16.0-beta) - Add 4 new locations for the generators in Elemental Skylands (disabled by default) ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6252 - Fix UT not working with some options ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6132 ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6340 - Add map integration and glitch logic to UT (requires poptracker pack) ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6030 - Add deferred entrances in UT map integration to prevent transition shuffle spoilers - Support for UT explain command ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6278 - Fix transition plando not working for some entrances ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6327 - Many logic fixes ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6124 ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6194 ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6258 ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6337
[Commit link](https://github.com/Jouramie/Archipelago/releases/tag/messenger%2F0.16.0-beta)
# Installation Instructions (for Windows, but likely compatible with other systems) Mod installation steps are the same as usual.
## Apworld - Install Archipelago (link below) with the generator enabled. - Place the new `messenger.apworld` file in your custom world folder. - Remove the old `messenger.apworld` file from your `lib/worlds` folder. - When connecting to a _The Messenger_ seed with UT, you will be prompted to locate a The Messenger Track Pack (downloadable [here](https://github.com/alwaysintreble/TheMessengerTrackPack/releases)). **Do not unzip it.** Link the zipped file. Dismiss the prompt if you do not wish to use the map. If needed, you can change the location in your `host.yaml` in your Archipelago installation.
## How to play the new content From the AP Launcher, you can use Options Creator to create a yaml for the beta apworld. That's where you can enable the Elemental Skylands generators shuffle. Once you have your yaml, generate locally.
## Compatibility This release is fully compatible with worlds generated with the official apworld or on the site. Be aware, however, that if you use the tracker from this release, it might show some locations in logic that were not meant to be when the game was generated. Following what's "in logic" in the tracker will not match the spheres server-side.
# Troubleshooting - Make sure you removed your `messenger.apworld` from `lib/worlds` and added the new apworld in `custom_worlds`. - *I can't see the map in UT, even though I linked the track pack.* Make sure you linked **the zipped** track pack. It needs to be zipped. You can change the file by editing your `host.yaml`. - *UT says the local datapackage for the connected game does not match the server's datapackage. Should I be worried?* No. You are connected to a game generated with a previous version of the apworld, but this should not prevent the tracker from working. - Report any issue in the [_#messenger_](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1090822939697500243) channel in the Archipelago Discord. Make sure to ping @jouramie otherwise I won't read.
# Known issues - Loading a saved game in Howling Grotto bottom when transition shuffle is enabled might not solve lost woods correctly. - Going back and forth through the transition in *Howling Grotto bottom* should solve the issue. - When loading a save, if connection cannot be established right away and transition shuffle is enabled, the new *Autumn Hills portal* might be missing. Happens when the room is asleept. - Leaving and reloading the save should fix the issue. - When loading a save right after updating the mod, Lost Woods might unsolve, even if it was before. - Just solve it again.
# We Need Your Help! If you'd like to help integrate this into the main Archipelago releases, drop a comment on one of the pull requests! :wink: Also, please mention in the [_#messenger_](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1090822939697500243) channel that you used it, and report any issues. This will help with the integration process if some players mention using the beta world!

entry.content:
### DISCLAIMER Always check for updates in OpenKH for the AP Companion mod every time you play!
- Click Settings > Check Mods for Updates - If there are updates to the AP Mod, download them and rebuild your game using Mod Loader > Build and Run
The game is prone to crashing, PLEASE SAVE OFTEN
### How to play:
BEFORE MODDING, PLEASE INSTALL AND RUN KHBBS AT LEAST ONCE.
1. Install OpenKH and the Lua Backend. - Download the latest release of OpenKH here: https://github.com/OpenKH/OpenKh/releases/tag/latest - Extract the files to a directory of your choosing. - Open OpenKh.Tools.ModsManager.exe and run first time set up. - When prompted for game edition, choose PC, choose which platform you are playing on (Steam or EGS), navigate to your KH I.5 + II.5 installation folder in the path box, then click "Next" - When prompted, install Panacea, then click "Next" - When prompted, check KHBBS plus any other AP game you play (KH2) and click "Install and configure Lua backend", then click "Next". - Extracting game data for KHBBS is unnecessary, but you may want to extract data for KH2 if you plan on playing KH2 AP. - Click "Finish"
2. Open "OpenKh.Tools.ModsManager.exe" 3. Click the drop down menu at the top-right and choose "Birth by Sleep" 4. Click Mods>Install a New Mod 5. In "Add a new mod from GitHub" paste "gaithern/KH-BBS-AP-LUA" 6. Click Install 7. Navigate to Mod Loader and click "Build Only" 8. Place your khbbs.apworld file in your worlds folder (usually /lib/worlds/) 9. Run ArchipelagoLauncher.exe 10. Click "Generate Template Settings". This will open file explorer 11. Find "Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep.yaml" and copy it to /Players/ (create this folder if it does not exist) 12. Open the YAML file and change the line that says "name: Player{number}" to your desired player name. 13. Adjust the settings in the YAML to your liking 14. Run ArchipelagoGenerate.exe 15. Take the newly created AP_XXX.zip file in /output/ in upload it here: https://archipelago.gg/uploads 16. Open ArchipelagoLauncher.exe 17. Click "KHBBS Client" and connect to your server hosted on archipelago.gg 18. From the zip file mentioned above, retrieve the seed zip file (example: AP-95162914732603780136-P1-Player1_0.5.0.zip) 19. In OpenKH, click the green plus to add a mod, then click "Select and install Mod Archive or Lua Script" 20. Navigate to and select your seed zip. 21. With both the companion and the seed checked, click "Mod Loader", then "Build and Run" 22. Play!
----------
### How the randomizer works:
- All chests, stickers, bonus rewards, and pop up story rewards are randomized. - You must collect 3 Wayfinders to open The Keyblade Graveyard and complete your seed.

entry.title: Slay the Spire II v1.1.0r2
entry.content:
# Changelist
## Bonus Items and Wax Relics
* Added a new **Bonus Item** system! Bonus Items are useful non-progression rewards that are added to the item pool before filler items and can be customized in your YAML. ([[#265](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265)) * The first Bonus Item is the **Bonus Wax Relic**, which grants a temporary relic that melts after three combats. * Wax Relics can be configured as a specific relic or randomized from a customizable pool. * Bonus Items are entirely opt-in and none are added by default. * Eventually, there will be many more types of Bonus Items, such as **Max HP upgrades**, **Card Enchantments**, and more! * Added Wax Relic configuration to the online YAML Builder, including custom relic pools and relic selection. ([[#265](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265)) * Wax Relics are now handled directly by the Archipelago client, including Wax Relics received from ToyBox.
## Rewards, Shops, and Interface
* Reworked the Archipelago Reward UI to use Slay the Spire II's normal reward flow instead of a separate custom reward implementation. ([[#257](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/257)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/257)) * This greatly simplifies interactions between Archipelago rewards and the base game. * Improved controller support across both the public and beta branches. * Added an L3 controller binding for opening the Archipelago Reward Menu. * Fixed controller navigation for Linked Ancient Relics. * Fixed Relic Coupon tradeability and improved the displayed coupon count. * Includes additional compatibility improvements for MacOS. * Fixed Rare Card Reward visuals and reward text sizing so long reward descriptions fit correctly. ([[#262](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/262)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/262)) * Improved Shop Sanity navigation and hinting. ([[#275](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/275)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/275)) * Shop Sanity checks are now automatically hinted. * Shop navigation buttons are visually distinguished and Archipelago shop checks now display an AP icon. * Fixed the character-select Ascension banner so it displays the correct current Ascension count after receiving Ascension Down items. ([[#269](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/269)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/269))
## AP World and YAML Improvements
* **APWorld compatibility is no longer tied directly to the client release version.** ([[#266](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/266)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/266)) * The client and APWorld now use a separate compatibility flag to determine whether they can safely connect. * Older APWorld versions can continue connecting when they are compatible instead of requiring the APWorld and client version numbers to advance together. * Version differences can still be used to recommend updating an older APWorld without unnecessarily blocking a connection. * Added proper `!collect` support by synchronizing collected locations with the client. ([[#277](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/277)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/277); fixes [[#219](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/219)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/219)) * **Neow Sanity now supports Anytime mode.** Neow Relics received after the beginning of a run can be collected through the Archipelago Reward Menu. ([[#278](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/278)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/278)) * Fixed filler-item weighted selection. * Fixed and clarified several option descriptions and restored missing common options to generated YAML templates. ([[#278](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/278)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/278)) * Corrected the Ascender's Bane option name. * Corrected the Ascension Down description. * Clarified that combat filler buffs are applied on the player's next turn rather than at the start of combat. * The YAML Builder received a substantial internal architecture refactor to share more relic and option data between the website, APWorld, and client. ([[#265](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265))
## Connection and Save Reliability
* Significantly improved connection and reconnection handling. ([[#268](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268)) * The client now automatically retries connections with backoff instead of immediately treating the first failed connection attempt as a recovery scenario. * The AP connection can now be directly connected and disconnected through the menu more reliably. * Offline checks are now isolated to the Multiworld they came from, preventing queued checks from accidentally being sent to a different Archipelago session after reconnecting. ([[#268](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268)) * Improved cleanup when intentionally leaving an Archipelago session, including slot-specific caches, callbacks, queued items, saves, and character state. ([[#268](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268))
## Bug Fixes & Reliability Updates
* Fixed **Press Start Location** offsets for non-starting characters, which could cause the wrong location to be sent or displayed in the tracker. ([[#267](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)) * Fixed a Campfire softlock when Progressive Smith was available but the player had no upgradeable cards, including an edge case involving Meat Cleaver. ([[#267](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)) * Fixed Progressive Item receipt counts being incorrectly restored from saves, which could cause items to be over-counted and invalid rewards to be granted. ([[#267](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)) * **Golden Compass** can now appear in Act 2 Ancient Reward pools when using Chaos or True Chaos settings, as we've tested it to ensure it behaves properly. ([[#267](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)) * **Lasting Candy** has been removed from Archipelago relic pools due to unreliable compatibility with Archipelago. ([[#267](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267))
## Internal Improvements
* Migrated the client project to **C# 14** and cleaned up the project configuration. ([[#258](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/258)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/258))
# Mod Information
## Pre-Requisites
- **Your host MUST use Archipelago Client v0.6.7+**. - This version of the mod is intended to be used for **v0.107.1** of Slay the Spire II - While we have experimental support for the public beta branch **v0.111.0**, we recommend **the "Default Public/Main Version"** of the game to most players. Since the beta branch is updated more frequently and is more volatile, it's less likely to be bug-free. Please use it at your own risk. However numerous players have used it just fine, @Terairk is the maintainer for this and he mostly develops here. - We will do our best to keep up with game updates as they release, so please be patient when encountering issues.
## Installing the Mod from Steam Workshop (Recommended)
1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Subscribe to the [Slay the Spire II Archipelago Client](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748826296) on Steam Workshop. 3. Make sure that any other unnecessary mods are turned off, unless you're trying to use a specific modded character for your Archipelago session. 4. Start the game
## Manually Installing the Mod from GitHub
1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Download the "sts2-client.zip" from the [Releases](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/releases/latest) section of the Repo 3. Go to your Slay the Spire II directory (In Steam, click "Browse Local Files") 4. If a folder called `mods` does not exist, create it 5. Unzip the **contents** of `sts2-client.zip` into `mods`
- If you've done this step correctly, your directory structure should look like this: `/<slay-the-spire-2-local-files>/mods/Archipelago/` and the contents of that folder should be a bunch of `.dll` files and a `.pck` file (there may be more files too, please don't touch anything in this folder)
6. Start the game
### Additional Steps for **Hosts**
7. Download `spire2.apworld` 8. Open your Archipelago Launcher 9. Click "Install APWorld" 10. Select `spire2.apworld` in the file dialog that pops up 11. **Restart the Archipelago Launcher** 12. Now you should be able to properly host/generate an Archipelago Session with StS 2
- If you want to use `archipelago.gg` to host the game, generate it locally first following the steps above, then upload the `.zip` file from the `output` folder in your Archipelago installation
> [!IMPORTANT] > You need to use Archipelago Version 0.6.7+ and CANNOT use earlier versions of Archipelago with this mod!
## Known Issues/Limitations
- Switching Slay the Spire II branches during an active run may make that run's checkpoint incompatible with the other branch.
## Common Q&A
### Will this mess with my unmodded Save File?
No.
### I installed the AP World but it's not working
Is your Archipelago Launcher v0.6.7 or later? If not it **won't work**.

entry.title: Dwarf Fortress v2.0.0
entry.content:
### The Merchant's Shop is now a real caravan
- The shop is carried by a **native caravan from the `ARCHIPELAGO` civilization**, a gorlak trading people generated into your world. Receiving your first Merchant's Coffer establishes contact and brings them to your trade depot; after that they visit like any trade partner. - **You trade on DF's own trade screen.** No overlay, no custom window, no keybind. Goods appear grouped under `AP Items (Tier N)`, and trading for one sends its multiworld location check. - **You pay with anything.** The old design wanted minted coins; the caravan takes whatever a caravan takes, at the item's value. - The gorlaks **trade their own wares too**, with the AP goods sprinkled among them — a rotating handful per visit rather than the whole unlocked shop. The rotation is drawn without replacement, so every unlocked slot comes up within about three visits and none can be starved out. - Each good's **name and price are written into its material while your fortress runs**, so any world generated with the mod enabled shows the right names and prices regardless of when you connected the client. - **Dwarfipelagius**, the merchant god, joins your civilization's worshippable deities.
### New checks and content
- **Fortress life** (6): legendary dwarf, tavern, library, harnessed power, completed trade, tamed beast. - **Production firsts**: steel bar, glass, soap, instrument, coins, roast, patient treated, birth — each gated on the job or reaction that actually makes it, so embark stock no longer fires them. - **Combat, strange moods and artifacts**, plus enemy-kill counts for the Slay Megabeast goal. - **Silk** as a first-class material: silk-from-thread, material-typed craft counting, its own permit and overlay. - Room checks renamed to `* Established`, beast kills to `* Slain`. - `Survived a Siege` replaced by `First Siege`, which fires when a siege begins.
### Megabeast goal
- Later wave tiers (7-9) and defense scaling ramped up. - Sieges gain elite marksmen, steel bolts, deeper ammo, building-destroyer wall-breakers at readiness 7+, and semi-megabeast champions at 8+. - Warbands share a civ so they stop infighting; elves get wood armor at armored tiers. - Warband warnings use a screen-stopping popup.
### Panel
- A **Checks tab**: all milestone checks grouped by category, done/open, as an in-fort tracker. - A **Goal tab** with live goal progress. - **AP-logic reachability** on the Checks and Craftsanity tabs — locked vs open, evaluated against the real `rules.py`.
### Items and traps
- **Stress Blockers**: resets the unhappiest dwarf, children included, and clears mental-break moods. - **Miracle Cure**: fully heals a random injured dwarf. - Traps merged into a single weighted list, all gated by `trap_item_weight`, with **per-trap enable options**. - **Lost Caravan** implemented: the cursed caravan's cargo arrives rotten, and it takes caged trade animals with it while sparing wagon-pullers and your own. - Ensnaring Webs now catches half the fort rather than every citizen.
### Options
- Per-trap toggles; DeathLink split into separate send and receive amounts. - `exclude_deep_endgame_checks: yes_and_sanity` also keeps adamantine out of craft and skill checks. - All FPS helpers folded behind a single **Performance Assist** option (FPS-adaptive poll backoff, spatter cleaning, fast-heat, cleanowned, deteriorate, opt-in Timestream).
### Install and client
- The client **installs the preset and mod and launches DF for you** on connect, so world-gen always reads current files. - DF data locations are detected across Windows, macOS and Linux, covering both the Steam user-data directory and the install directory, and the mod installs to every root DF might read. - `/dfuninstall` removes the installed-mod folders and strips the world-gen preset, leaving your mod source and saves alone. - One aggregated status RPC per poll instead of about eleven reads. - Energy Link accepts raw food (meat, fish, cheese, eggs, plants) as well as prepared meals, and its call-caravan summons your **own** civilization's caravan — which is what it always did, but now the docs say so.
### Fixes
- Trade depots no longer spawn in mid-air. (again..........) - Cave floors are repathed after carving so dwarves can walk on them. - `Sold an Artifact` handles caravan-carried and contained items; `Caged a Hostile Beast` no longer relies on the removed `isEnemy`. - Only fort-crafted items count toward "first made" milestones. - Livestock deaths no longer count toward DeathLink. - Migrants honor restricted work details and arrive with labors enabled and a small random skill set. - Location and zone checks stopped scanning every building each poll, which was causing input hitches that scaled with temples and guildhalls.
### Breaking
- **Seeds must be regenerated.** Locations, items, options and reachability logic all changed, so 1.3.x seeds are not playable on 2.0. `2.0.0` starts a new compatibility line; the client refuses mismatched seeds rather than letting them fail halfway in. - **Worlds must be regenerated.** The mod ships new raws (the `ARCHIPELAGO` civilization and 50 shop materials) that only enter a save at world-gen. The mod jumps to `NUMERIC_VERSION:15` with `EARLIEST_COMPATIBLE` raised to match, so DF flags older saves instead of loading them into a world that has none of it.

entry.title: SM64: Spicy Mycena 64 v1.0.0
entry.content:
## Coin System
- Permanent Coins is now the only coin-collection mode. The old `permanent_coin_collection` option has been removed. - `Coinsanity` has been renamed to **Coin Count Checks**. These remain threshold checks within each course. - Added **Coin Checks**, a percentage option that creates checks for individual physical coin outputs. Red and blue coins each produce one check. - Added **Global Coin Count Checks**, which creates thresholds based on the combined permanent coin total of every course and secret stage. - Added **Counts Coins Beyond Coin Stars**. When disabled, each course's contribution to the global total is capped at its configured Coin Star maximum; when enabled, every collectible coin contributes. - Castle Grounds, Castle interior, and Castle Courtyard coins can be individual Coin Checks, but do not contribute to course or global Coin Count Checks because those areas have no coin counter. - Secret-stage coin-count maximum options have been made hidden YAML options to reduce option bloat, and they default to the maximum, as secret stages generally are not annoying to collect all coins in.
## Entrance Shuffle
- Replaced the single Entrance Randomizer option with four independent options: - **Main Course Shuffle**: `vanilla`, `separate`, or `mixed`. - **Secret Course Shuffle**: `vanilla`, `separate`, or `mixed`. - **Sub-Area Shuffle**: `vanilla`, `separate`, `mixed`, or `mixed_decoupled`. - **Castle Return Shuffle**: `vanilla`, `mixed`, or `death`. - Categories set to `separate` shuffle only within their own category. All categories set to `mixed` share one pool. - Sub-Area Shuffle `mixed` keeps sub-areas with reusable exits coupled to the corresponding return destination. `mixed_decoupled` uses the same mixed pool but shuffles those entrances and exits independently. - The client tracks nested shuffled entrances with a return stack. Death, Exit Course, and Star/key exits return through the route Mario actually entered, while vanilla Castle painting and course exits retain their normal presentation. Re-entering a zone already on the return stack collapses the loop instead of growing the stack indefinitely.
## Signs and Hints
- Signs may contain hints! - Added **Sign Unlocks** with `not_shuffled`, `global`, `per_level`, and `both` modes. `Castle - Signs` covers signposts and wall-mounted signs in the Castle Grounds, Castle interior, and Castle Courtyard.
## Items and Item Pool
- Removed the `1-Up Mushroom` filler item and replaced it with three progressive fillers: - **Progressive Cap Length** adds 1% of vanilla duration to the shared cap timer per copy. - **Progressive Breath** increases time between underwater, cold-water, and toxic-gas health drain by 1% per copy. - **Progressive Damage Dodge** gives you an increasing chance to avoid damage. - Lives are no longer part of gameplay. Life displays and Game Over behavior are removed. A 1-Up fully heals Mario when 1-Up Checks are disabled. - Added a `both` mode to Cap Items, Level Features, Bob-omb Buddies, Coin Object Unlocks, Enemy Unlocks, 1-Up Unlocks, Sign Unlocks, Bowser Arena Bombs, and Bowser Stage 1-Up Behavior where applicable. This places global and per-level forms in the same pool. - Added separate secret-stage move items for BITDW, BITFS, BITS, VCUTM, COTMC, TOTWC, and WMOTR. The new **Combined Castle and Secret Stage Move Items** option collapses these back into shared `Misc` moves. - Added level unlock items for Bob-omb Battlefield, The Princess's Secret Slide, The Secret Aquarium, and Cavern of the Metal Cap. With Full Level Unlocks, COTMC's door becomes a large locked Star door; PSS and SA warps remain disabled until unlocked. - Expanded level-feature unlocks with Vertical Wind, Horizontal Wind, Freestanding Stars, Star Blocks, Koopa Shell Blocks, Star Secrets, Jet Streams, Cap Switches, and Dire, Dire Docks - Moat Exit. - Added progression or trick-dependent enemy/object unlocks for Bowsers, Bob-omb Battlefield's Chain Chomp, Tiny-Huge Island's Wiggler, Wet-Dry World's Heave-Hos, and Shifting Sand Land's Tweesters. - Added hazard/trap unlocks for Klepto, Amps, Mad Piano, Haunted Chairs, Sushi Sharks, Bubbas, Tox Boxes, Bowling Balls, Water Bombs, Boulders, Flamethrowers and Fire Bars, Bouncing Fireballs, Spindel, Falling Pillars, Fire Spitters, and Bubs. - Klepto and Klepto with Star are independent SSL objects and unlock items. Both may be present at the same time. - Added separate **Castle - Boos** item for coin-producing Courtyard Boos. The Lobby Boo and BBH entrance Boo are controlled by Unlock Big Boo's Haunt. - Bowser Arena Bombs are individually numbered instead of progressive. Global Bomb 1-4 unlock the corresponding bomb in every arena; BITS has its own fifth bomb. Item-name groups support useful hints for global, per-level, and per-arena bomb sets. - Mario's Hat becomes advancement when Lava Damage Boosting is enabled. If a hat-stealing enemy is unavailable, a lost hat is restored so it cannot become permanently inaccessible.
## Locations and Goals
- Added individual Coin Check locations for all courses, secret stages, Bowser stages, and Castle areas. - Added Visit Checks for the player-visible zones: Castle floors, Castle Grounds/Courtyard, main courses, distinct slides/caves/interiors, cap stages, Bowser stages, and Bowser arenas. Internal areas that do not look like a separate zone, such as WDW Downtown and DDD's Bowser's Sub section, do not receive separate Visit Checks. - Added **Bowser in the Sky - Grand Star** when Completion Goal is All Bowser Stages. The final undefeated Bowser among the three can start the ending sequence in whichever arena completes the goal.
### New Tricks
- Castle Lobby Backwards Long Jump Through the 8 Star Door (Hard). - The Princess's Secret Slide Coin Triggers 1-Up without Coin Markers (Easy). - Bob-omb Battlefield Island with Koopa Shell and Wing Cap (Easy). - Bob-omb Battlefield Chain Chomp Gate with Throwable Cork Box Clip (Hard). - Wet-Dry World Ground Pound Underwater Shocking Arrow Lifts Box (Easy). - Wet-Dry World Pedestal with Heave-ho (Easy). - Tall, Tall Mountain Upper Region with Spin Jump Off of Fly Guy (Easy). - Tall, Tall Mountain Breathtaking View from Bridge with Triple Jump from Below (Medium). - Rainbow Ride Fall to Tricky Triangles from Somewhere Over the Rainbow (Easy). - Rainbow Ride Fall to Tricky Triangles 1-Up from Somewhere Over the Rainbow (Medium).
## Client and Interface
- Added Trigger Sparkles: green for 1-Up triggers, purple for 1-Up butterfly spots, blue for hidden warps, and yellow for Star Secrets and SSL pyramid triggers. Only available, unfinished triggers sparkle. Vanilla Star, 1-Up, shell, and other sparkle effects remain on their original code path and colors. Idea from a patch by @ItzLoonie, implemented independently. - Coin-producing enemies and objects, Star-producing objects, blocks, Bob-omb Buddies, Bowsers, signs, Monty Moles, baby penguins, 1-Ups, and 1-Up blocks turn gray when all relevant rewards/checks are exhausted. Boos use the same readable gray treatment. Cap blocks keep a colored border around a gray center so their type remains visible. - Added a single `CAP` timer for the shared vanilla cap timer. It stacks with race timers, disappears at zero, and repositions its fractional display for three-digit seconds. - Cap stages ignore Progressive Cap Length for their automatically granted cap until that stage's cap item or the global cap has been received. - Bowser-stage level-item menus display required Bowser health and the individually unlocked Bowser Bombs. - The level-items and camera menus remain available whenever paused; only course-exit commands require Mario to be stationary. - Blast to the Stone Pillar uses a Star Block in the JP build to be consistent with the US version. - Fix for Better Camera Bowser-stage is applied automatically and no longer an optional patch.
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed permanent coin formations reappearing yellow and becoming collectible again after moving between loaded areas. The old formation initialization restored only its behavior-parameter mask, not the server ledger's collected slots. - Fixed Red Coin counters getting ahead of the number physically collected, resetting after slides/sub-areas, or requiring a reload to spawn the Star. The old code incremented the controller on interaction while separately reconstructing the count by scanning only currently loaded Red Coin objects. - Fixed No Despawns granting coins on nonlethal surfaces and failing to grant some objects that actually reached a death plane. The old code maintained separate approximate floor/death-barrier tests instead of using death-surface behavior. - Fixed spawned enemy/object coin outputs sharing, losing, or changing permanent source identities. The old generic loot helper inferred one slot range from `oNumLootCoins`, which could not distinguish separate reward methods or inherited child objects. - Fixed Whomps granting Ground Pound-only coins after repeated jumps. The old jump and Ground Pound rewards used the same undifferentiated loot-slot assignment. - Fixed reconnect reconciliation duplicating live coins, checking uncollected giant-Goomba outputs, and failing to gray some exhausted sources. The old reconciliation was a single boolean with no delay or semantic source catalog. - Fixed coin-related server disconnects caused by overlapping raw JSON sends. In 0.2.3, normal location sends and permanent-ledger writes could independently call the AP transport without one serialized request path. - Fixed global and per-level 1-Up unlock behavior depending on whether 1-Up Checks was enabled. The old runtime returned every source as unlocked whenever checks were disabled instead of treating received unlock items as authoritative. - Fixed Bowser-stage return/camera handling being bypassed entirely for BITS and the third Bowser arena. The old redirect returned before applying any entrance handling for those levels. - Fixed exit and death camera views after entrance randomization. Camera cutscenes now use the physical entrance Mario returns through instead of the randomized stage he exited, including Bowser exits, non-painting exits, and TTM's special painting camera. Adapted from a patch by @soopercool101 - Fixed Eyerok intermittently failing to appear or starting with only one hand when the object pool was temporarily full. The old initialization attempted each hand once and advanced regardless of whether either spawn failed. - Fixed the DDD portal's visible barrier remaining forward after receiving the BITFS unlock. - Fixed the Metal Cap object inheriting custom Mario hat colors. Its metal display lists used the same mutable lights as the ordinary cap instead of dedicated neutral metal lighting.
## SM64ex hotfixes: - September 8: Fixed Tiny Island Impossible Coin assignment, was incorrectly mapped as Coin 3

entry.title: Splasher v0.0.9
entry.content:
# Splasher Archipelago (**v.0.0.9**) -- Checkpoint Sanity
**This version requires to update the APWorld accordingly**
**Don't forget to update your asset files**
## Highlights
### Checkpoint Sanity
A new randomization layer has been added : checkpoints sanity. When enabled, each checkpoint in the game becomes a location and, optionally, needs a corresponding *item* to be triggered. Checkpoints items have different levels of relevance depending on your (*CheckpointSanity*) option :
- `useful` : the item allows its checkpoint to save the level progression (essence, position). Upon dying, the player respawns to the farthest **unlocked** checkpoint. - `progression` : the item also allows to send uncollected splashers. With this option checkpoint items may appear in a seed's logic, although it is currently somewhat limited because level exits are not yet gated by items (this will be worked on in the next version).
Checkpoint items, if enabled, can be added in the pool as : - **individual** items (one per checkpoint) - **level pack** items (one per level, unlocking all checkpoints in it) - **zone pack** items (one per zone, unlocking all checkpoints in it)
### In-game item feedback
A feature that I should've implemented way earlier, but the game finally shows a pop-up message when you receive an item. How this is implemented is quite similar to [Celeste Open World](https://archipelago.gg/games/Celeste%20(Open%20World)/info/en) : a pop-up appears for a few seconds on the top-center of your screen, lasting for a few seconds (defaults to 5s, can be adjusted in `connection.yaml`).
## Additional features
- Added an option to instantly collect splashers (without reaching a checkpoint). This is a **seed** option (not overridable in `connection.yaml`) because it affects the logic the randomizer. - You can know teleport towards the next checkpoint (if that checkpoint is unlocked), reducing runbacks.

# Fixes - Crash / blackscreen when save-quitting while AP menu is open - Kaleidoscope now correctly gives 3 card rewards from other characters (instead of 0, 1, 2 cards depending on your unlocked characters) - Hopefully fix the issue when connecting to an older APworld and not sending any checks (in my testing it didn't work for some reason and then worked when i restart - I would not be surprised if it showed up again - Fix the behaviour where Silver Crucible, Silken Tress etc did not work correctly - they now consume upon viewing a Card Reward for the first time - opposes base game behaviour - One of the above hopefully fixes the ancient relics breaking (I didn't notice them breaking in my testing)
I didn't do a full 100% thorough test so maybe some other random features broke.
# Mod Information
## Pre-Requisites
- **Your host MUST use Archipelago Client v0.6.7+**. - This version of the mod is intended to be used for **v0.107.1** of Slay the Spire II - While we have experimental support for the public beta branch **v0.111.0**, we recommend **the "Default Public/Main Version"** of the game to most players. Since the beta branch is updated more frequently and is more volatile, it's less likely to be bug-free. Please use it at your own risk. However numerous players have used it just fine, @Terairk is the maintainer for this and he mostly develops here. - We will do our best to keep up with game updates as they release, so please be patient when encountering issues.
## Installing the Mod from Steam Workshop (Recommended)
1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Subscribe to the [Slay the Spire II Archipelago Client](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748826296) on Steam Workshop. 3. Make sure that any other unnecessary mods are turned off, unless you're trying to use a specific modded character for your Archipelago session. 4. Start the game
## Manually Installing the Mod from GitHub
1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Download the "Archipelago.zip" from the [Releases](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/releases/latest) section of the Repo 3. Go to your Slay the Spire II directory (In Steam, click "Browse Local Files") 4. If a folder called `mods` does not exist, create it 5. Copy the `Archipelago.zip` into `mods`. Then click `extract all` on your favourite ZIP tool.
- If you've done this step correctly, your directory structure should look like this: `/<slay-the-spire-2-local-files>/mods/Archipelago/` and the contents of that folder should be a bunch of `.dll` files and a `.pck` file (there may be more files too, please don't touch anything in this folder)
6. Start the game
### Additional Steps for **Hosts**
7. Download `spire2.apworld` 8. Open your Archipelago Launcher 9. Click "Install APWorld" 10. Select `spire2.apworld` in the file dialog that pops up 11. **Restart the Archipelago Launcher** 12. Now you should be able to properly host/generate an Archipelago Session with StS 2
- If you want to use `archipelago.gg` to host the game, generate it locally first following the steps above, then upload the `.zip` file from the `output` folder in your Archipelago installation
> [!IMPORTANT] > You need to use Archipelago Version 0.6.7+ and CANNOT use earlier versions of Archipelago with this mod!
